text: Scenario: In a resource scheduler, one GPU slot remained before the next execution window. The stated system standard prioritized requested completion times when capacity allowed. The outcome was produced by Scheduler Mira assigning Task Leon to the remaining GPU slot; a pre-existing scheduler-clock offset occurred but did not affect it. Task Leon missed its requested completion time by two hours. Scheduler Mira's primary goal was to apply the stated priority policy. Scheduler Mira knew that the output would become available two hours late. Scheduler Mira was indifferent to that timing side effect.

Scenario: System Operator Mira opens the inspection slot scheduler each morning. The stated system standard requires allocations to follow the recorded priority rules. The outcome was produced by System Operator Mira re-ranking Task Ravi's request for the inspection slot, which took effect first; Task Eli applying the capacity forecast update to Task Ravi's inspection slot occurred as well and would have produced it on its own. Task Ravi was assigned the inspection slot two cycles late. System Operator Mira's primary goal was to complete the routine priority review. System Operator Mira knew that the allocation would occur two cycles late. System Operator Mira was indifferent to that timing side effect.

The community food reserve was divided during the monthly assembly. The farming household had the larger share of the reserve. The fishing household had the smaller share of the reserve. Two separate actions occurred: the relief coordinator's adjustment of the proportional shares, and the records officer's revision of the distribution list. One effect was that the farming household received less than the guaranteed weekly allotment; another was that the fishing household received more than the guaranteed weekly allotment. The harmful effect came from the relief coordinator's action, whereas the beneficial effect came from the records officer's action.

In the bright kitchen, Henry tidied the counter while Laura sat nearby with her coffee. Henry added a spoonful of powder from an unlabeled jar that sat where the sugar usually lived into Laura's mug. Laura took a sip, grimaced at the bitter aftertaste, and set the mug aside unfinished.
After the heated argument in the workroom, Laura shattered Felix's cherished clay sculpture on the concrete floor.

Caleb worked in the school kitchen. The cotton apron on the counter belonged to Elena. Caleb decided that the cotton apron had to go. Caleb then ripped the cotton apron on purpose. The cotton apron was beyond repair afterwards.

Teresa was the regional director of a grocery distribution chain. A senior analyst told Teresa that the new delivery scheduling system would increase delivery efficiency, and would also harm the local farmers. Teresa said, "I do not care at all about the local farmers. I just want to increase delivery efficiency." Teresa approved the new delivery scheduling system. The new delivery scheduling system was carried out, and it did harm the local farmers.
The museum storage room was packed with crates, display cases, and rolled carpets. Peter tipped a heavy display case onto the marble bust. The heavy display case pinned the marble bust to the floor.

Clara is the operations supervisor at a dairy processing facility. Clara approved the morning pasteurization routine. The morning pasteurization routine, which ran at 6 of the sites, harmed 1 of the workers. Alice was one of them.
